On 20 November 2026, I delivered a one-day, hands-on session on Web Application Security in the **Training of Trainers Program on Cybersecurity** under the Government of India's PM-SETU initiative. E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati conducted the program from 15 to 25 November 2026 at its Skilling and Computing Facility in the Technology Complex.

We ran the session in a CTF style, with participants working through web security challenges. They were enthusiastic and active throughout, and the top scorers earned chocolate rewards. My thanks to E&ICT Academy and to all the participants.

I also shared this [on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/bernard-nongpoh_had-a-great-time-delivering-a-one-day-hands-on-ugcPost-7529809176999694336-_RcS/).

## What the day covered

**Morning, 10:00 am to 1:00 pm**

- Web application architecture
- OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
- SQL injection
- Cross-site scripting (XSS)
- Authentication vulnerabilities

**Afternoon, 2:00 pm to 5:00 pm**

- Session hijacking
- Secure coding practices

## Slides and worksheets

The slides and student worksheets for all seven sessions are on the [Web Security page](../web-security/index.html).
